notes.title: Derivation of the Tolman–Oppenheimer–Volkoff Equations
notes.excerpt: A careful derivation of the TOV equations from the Einstein field equations applied to a static, spherically symmetric perfect fluid. Starting from the Schwarzschild metric ansatz and the stress-energy tensor of a perfect fluid.

notes.title: A Bayesian Primer for Equation of State Inference
notes.excerpt: How to set up a Bayesian inference problem for neutron star EOS constraints. Covers prior construction from nuclear physics, likelihood construction from NICER and GW data, and posterior sampling strategies.

notes.title: Nuclear Symmetry Energy: Constraints and Open Questions
notes.excerpt: Review of current experimental and observational constraints on the nuclear symmetry energy slope parameter L, from isospin diffusion experiments to neutron star radius measurements.

notes.title: MCMC Convergence Diagnostics for High-Dimensional EOS Sampling
notes.excerpt: Practical notes on diagnosing convergence in high-dimensional MCMC chains for EOS inference. Covers Gelman-Rubin diagnostics, autocorrelation lengths, and when to trust your posterior.

notes.title: Open Questions on the Hadron-Quark Phase Transition
notes.excerpt: A working list of unresolved questions about the hadron-quark phase transition in neutron star interiors. What are the observational signatures? Is the Maxwell construction physical?

notes.title: Working Notes: Interpreting NICER X-ray Posteriors
notes.excerpt: Notes on how to properly use NICER mass-radius posterior samples in an EOS inference pipeline. Covers coordinate conventions, KDE interpolation of posteriors, and common pitfalls.
